name: Zillah
description: Woman living at the time before the Flood

points: “And Lamech took unto him two wives”: the first time you read about polygamy is here, in Cain’s kids. “The name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.”

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: “And Lamech took unto him two wives”. Keep that name Lamech in mind: Enoch had Lamech, on Cain’s line. These are Cainites, the wicked. The name of the one was Adah, wife one; the name of the other Zillah, wife two.

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: “And Zillah, she also bare Tubal–cain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron”: an instructor, a teacher; artificer means invention. He was able to take metal and invent things with it. Spoons and forks? No. He made brass and iron into weapons. What does a smith spend his time around? Fire. And what did the angel have in his hand? A flaming sword. This is war. To make brass and iron weaponry you have to know how to handle fire, to melt it, smelt it down, hammer it, the temperature of the heat to melt the metal down, mold it and shape it. They’re sweating in a furnace all day long. The angel showed him that.

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: “And Zillah, she also bare Tubal–cain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron”: a spear smith, a weapon smith.
